_about: Named review views of the Chapter 2 scene, shared by the dev review panel (?dev=1&view=NAME) and tools/tests/review_shots.js. 'at' is story time: seconds, or a timeline mark from the scene (lid0, lidGo, door1 …) with an optional offset like 'lidGo+0.8'. 'pos'/'look' are town units; camera 'story' uses the visitor's own shot (desktop or phone composition) instead.

hall-front.note: the Community Hall sign and both upper windows, straight on

hall-angle.note: the sign at an angle, both upper windows and their shutters

lid-closed.note: the drop-off box, lid shut, the Marine's hand at the lip

lid-half.note: the lid half open, from the side

lid-open-side.note: the lid fully open, edge-on: it must stop short of the sign

lid-open.note: the open lid and the sign behind it, from the street

lid-story.note: the visitor's own shot at that moment (desktop or phone)

doorway.note: the hall door open, the lit entrance room behind it

doorway-story.note: the visitor's own shot of the open door
